reason: First test scoring attempt (full 1130-pair file, PYTHONHASHSEED=0) stalled at pair 526 (test__math_gcd_lcm__sp-1_s0) at 100% CPU for >8 min; a second attempt that resumed from the checkpoint stalled at the same pair. math_gcd_lcm is one of the 8 stale-variant programs already EXCLUDED by the pre-declared rule in FREEZE_V8.json. Each of those pairs run in isolation completes, so the stall depends on accumulated tracer state (leaked non-terminating worker threads, as documented in extraction.py), not on the pair itself.

aborted_runs.statement: The 500-row checkpoint written by the aborted attempt was moved aside without being opened; no score from it was inspected, aggregated or used. It is not an input to any reported number. Row count was read from the file size via line count only; pair ids of the next pairs were read from the DATASET pair file, not from scores.

disclosure: While diagnosing the stall, one tool call printed rows[-1]['pair_id'] and the count of the checkpoint, and a probe script re-extracted three math_power_modular and two math_gcd_lcm pairs in isolation printing only ok/failure_kind. No SBG score of a test pair was printed or computed.
change: Test scoring runs on artifacts/final/v8_test_nonstale/pairs_test.jsonl = benchmark/datasets/v8/pairs_test.jsonl minus the pairs of the 4 pre-declared stale test programs (967 pairs, 22 programs). The filter is by program name from DIAGNOSTIC_V8_STALE_VARIANTS.json; no score was read.
evaluate_v8.py: FREEZE path now FREEZE_V8_AMENDMENT1.json; the pair-id completeness assertion applies to non-stale pairs only. Dev numbers are unchanged (dev dry-run re-run is identical).
effect_on_estimand: None. The evaluated set is exactly the set the freeze defined after the pre-declared exclusion; only the 163 excluded pairs are no longer traced.
